runSummary.zh: 2026-11-13：新增7条，实质修订3条既有记录，共复核8条既有记录。覆盖中国大陆、香港及台澳线索、欧洲、北美、韩国，并定向搜索多国公共采购；未对来源目录全量抓取。首尔以市府简章更正为12月9日16:00 KST；德国奖开报日冲突置空。新增含北京设计采购、釜山生态艺术、美国公园资格征集与研究资助；部分仅协会或官方摘要证据，已标partial/secondary及报名未知。TED405、首尔市门户、澎湖超时、ArchLeague403及部分附件受阻；目录旧缓存、台采购批次日期冲突、已授标/养护/广泛商业奖不作开放机会充数。保留全部旧记录和firstSeen；各条核查程度不同，未截止不等于仍可新报名。 本次快照42条提交未截止：开放24、待开报1、报名/文件获取已结束仍可提交8、状态待核实9；另有1条归档。开放是现有证据下的索引状态，并非本轮逐条重新认证。
runSummary.en: 13 November:7 additions,3 substantive revisions and8 existing records reviewed. Targeted mainland China, Hong Kong/Taiwan/Macao leads, Europe, North America, Korea and multinational public procurement; not a full directory crawl. Seoul cutoff corrected from the city brief to9 December16:00 KST; conflicting German opening dates set null. Additions include Beijing design procurement, Busan ecological art, US park qualification and research funding. Association-only/search-excerpt evidence marked partial/secondary with unknown entry access where appropriate. TED405, Seoul portal, Penghu timeout, ArchLeague403 and some attachments blocked; stale indexes, conflicting Taiwan batches, awarded/maintenance contracts and broad commercial awards excluded from open-call additions. All old records/firstSeen retained; unexpired does not mean open for new entry. Snapshot:42 unexpired submissions—24 open,1 upcoming,8 registered-only and9 uncertain;1 archived. Open reflects accumulated evidence, not a fresh full verification of every record.
